summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-ext-common ships preinstall dropper that executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package declares `preinstall`: `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<platform>.zip), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run `math_init.js`, a 727KB obfuscated JavaScript bundle shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is an obfuscator.io-style bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, string-array rotator `WV8StW`, hex-named identifiers, ~1000-entry mixed literal table `n7gIxM=[...]`) with no human-readable code. `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated. The package presents itself as a React form-wrapper component library, which has no functional need to fetch a second language runtime at install time and use it specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload — using Bun bypasses Node-centric analysis. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the runtime install is only the delivery mechanism for executing obfuscated content shipped inside the tarball, so the aggressive-but-legitimate official-runtime carve-out does not apply.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
